model.name: merge.responsiveSplineRibbon
model.description: One continuous cubic-bezier spline ribbon per change flows across the 3 editors (Local->Result->Repository), absorbing per-pane Y offsets; responsive - mobile stacks the panes (spline flows down), desktop is side-by-side (spline across); subtle kind-colored shading, no boxes. Impl-edit anchor renderConnectorRibbons (replace boxes/bands); architect adds the responsive-layout method-set (re-point to built).
